snippet.title: The Lich Wars - Official Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Check out gameplay and see how your choices shape the story in this trailer for The Lich Wars, a Story-Rich Gothic RPG from the creators of The Necromancer's Tale. In The Lich Wars, live as a musketeer in the 1700s, fighting through two wars of the undead in a 30-year career. Serve a country burdened by guilt & black magic, where necromancy infects the minds of its people. The Lich Wars is an interactive fiction with RPG skills and combat, deep characters and relationships. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2245710/The_Lich_Wars
